guide.title: Game Guide
guide.subtitle: How to get started with BOUT
guide.overviewDesc: BOUT is a 3D mech survival game. Fight off machine legions on a vast planet and survive for 15 minutes.
guide.objectiveDesc: Avoid enemy attacks and survive as long as possible. The longer you survive, the higher your score.
guide.combatMoveDesc: Move your mech with WASD or arrow keys
guide.combatJumpDesc: Press Space to jump. High ground is advantageous
guide.combatDoubleJumpDesc: Unlocked at Lv 10. Allows a 2nd jump in mid-air
guide.combatDashDesc: Press Shift to dash short distances. Great for dodging
guide.combatAimDesc: Auto-aim follows the nearest enemy. Firing is automatic
guide.upgradeDesc: Defeat enemies to gain XP and level up. On level-up, choose 1 of 3 cards.
guide.difficultyDesc: Enemies and bosses grow stronger over time. Killing bosses dramatically increases their HP and attack power.
guide.bossSpawnTime: Boss spawns every 30 seconds (decreases with level)
guide.bossTypes: 5 boss types cycling: Bear → Wolf → Dragon → Tiger → Iron Lord
guide.bossAoeAttack: Boss AOE attacks (circular warning shown on ground)
guide.monsterScaleHeader: All normal monsters scale with boss kills:
guide.monsterWave1: Wave 1: Basic monsters (Beta, Alpha, Fast Rusher)
guide.monsterWave2: Wave 2+: Chain Labor, Laser Boy, Bomb Drone added
guide.monsterWave3: Wave 3+: Tough Guy Z, Cargo Guard added
guide.tip1: Check the minimap to track enemy positions
guide.tip2: Fighting from high ground is advantageous
guide.tip3: A warning appears when a boss spawns
guide.tip4: Using dash for evasion is key to survival

hypersuit.name: Hypersuit
hypersuit.blurb: Solid HP and defense. Best for steady, forgiving runs.

azonas-v.name: Azonas V
azonas-v.blurb: High speed and damage. When you want mobility and DPS.

geren.name: Geren
geren.blurb: Top HP and defense. Strong in boss fights and brawls.

expressive.name: Expressive
expressive.blurb: Rigged GLB. Level/Form shift color, emissive, and PBR; no extra geometry bolted on. Combat uses this GLTF when selected.

soldier.name: Soldier
soldier.blurb: three.js sample Soldier.glb — Idle/Walk/Run skeletal blend. Same GLB loads in combat.

cyberpunk-human.name: Cyberpunk Human
cyberpunk-human.blurb: `cyberpunk_human.glb` — Idle/Walk/Run matched from clip names when available.

neon-human.name: Neon Human
neon-human.blurb: `neon_human.glb` — mobility-tuned stats; material evolution only (no attach meshes).
